state.goal: Implement live Jev decision workbench in SUNNY using the already selected interactive_gate route. Source data stays read-only; only explicit submitted decision assessments write hashed receipts through fixed scripts/jev_tool.py stdin bridge. State, question and at least two meaningful candidates must be visible/editable; full distributions/model identity/receipts displayed; no automatic canonical promotion.
state.facts: Root-provided wrapper accepts {state,questions:[{id,type:'choice',question,options}]} and emits actual answer/receipt SHA/model identity; max48000 UTF8 bytes and32questions. Read-only local source UI exists; server binds127.0.0.1. Existing driver choice and type declaration choice have real model receipts.
state.constraints: No source mutation, no arbitrary command paths/args, no scientific calibration claims, no silent fallback on model outage.

questions.question: Which input surface should be implemented now for the authorized browser Jev decision workbench?

options.structured_form: Provide editable state/context, one question and two or more explicit candidate ID/meaning rows; submit exactly the visible state and options with the fixed native choice contract; show request JSON before sending.
options.raw_json: Provide one editable native request JSON textarea supporting up to32questions with validation; no separate state/question/candidate controls; show the exact JSON before sending.

questions.question: How should the local browser bridge handle concurrent live decision submissions?

options.single_inflight: Permit one browser decision subprocess at a time and return a clear busy response to a concurrent submission; never queue hidden requests.
options.bounded_parallel: Permit up to two simultaneous browser decision subprocesses; reject further requests as busy; retain SQLite receipt transaction protection.
